pages: Foreground: a tall survey pole banded in red and white, stood upright in a field of long grass. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, kneeling with a level on its tripod. Background: a line of steel measuring pins down the lane, a stone farmhouse, the beck. Light: low autumn sun.

Foreground: a thick ledger lying open on a plain school desk, its covers worn through. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, standing with one hand on the desk. Background: a steel cupboard with its door ajar, a bare classroom, a tall window. Light: flat winter daylight.

Foreground: raw cut shale and a drain trench, new oak pegs at the corner of a small plot. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, walking the cut track between the pegged plots. Background: nineteen terraces stepping up the hillside, the beck, roofs of Keld below. Light: bright cold spring morning.

Foreground: a noticeboard of loose papers nailed to the wall outside the shop, edges curled by weather. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, standing a step back from it. Background: the lane, a stone wall, bare hedges. Light: still grey January light.

Foreground: an open crate of stacked china plates on the yard wall, ten deep. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, leaning on the wall beside it. Background: five oak trunks along the top of the yard, a stone farmhouse, the lane. Light: bright May light.

Foreground: a level on its tripod, the bubble dead centre, set on the cobbles of the lane. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, kneeling with one eye on the eyepiece. Background: a line of steel measuring pins running downhill, a long grass hillside, the beck. Light: hard noon sun.

Foreground: a steel pin set flush in a concrete block, its head ringed and polished bright. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, crouched with a folding rule laid across it. Background: long grass falling to the beck, the Brow above. Light: high summer noon.

Foreground: an open notebook on a flat-topped wall, a pencil laid across the page. Middle: Ruben, heavy, an orange hi-vis jacket, a notebook in one hand, standing beside a tall survey pole banded red and white. Background: a line of steel measuring pins up the lane, the beck, the hillside. Light: bright midday light.

Foreground: a tall survey pole banded red and white, held dead upright. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, both hands on the pole, sighting up the lane past it. Background: two steel measuring pins at the far end of the lane, the beck, a long grass hillside. Light: clear bright morning.

Foreground: a steel pin standing in a square of short-cut turf in the churchyard corner. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, kneeling with a levelling staff laid to the pin. Background: a stone church wall, gravestones, the roofs of Keld below. Light: flat overcast light.

Foreground: a hard-backed book lying open on a knee. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, sitting on a low stone wall by the Havel yard. Background: five oak trunks along the top of the yard, a stone farmhouse, the lane. Light: soft evening light.

Foreground: one printed sheet, folded once, spread flat on a bare wooden table. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, seated with one finger laid on the sheet. Background: a stone wall, a shelf, a shuttered window. Light: cold March light.

Foreground: a bundle of pinned sheets tied with string, squared on a plain table. Middle: Signe Rask, fifty-four, grey hair pinned up, both hands flat on the bundle. Background: a plain meeting room, stacked chairs, a window. Light: flat January light through the glass.

Foreground: a plain steel cupboard standing open, its shelves of bound volumes. Middle: Ruben, heavy, an orange hi-vis jacket, a notebook under one arm, standing in the open doorway. Background: a bare schoolroom, desks in rows, a tall window. Light: cold daylight from the window.

Foreground: a shovel stuck upright in a bed of newly turned shale. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, standing among the pegged square plots. Background: the New Row road, a new concrete drain, Keld far below. Light: bright morning light.

Foreground: a knee-high mark of paler stone along the inside wall of a stripped byre. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, standing in the byre doorway. Background: a broken stone sill in two pieces on the ground, a new concrete lintel, the yard. Light: bright May light.

Foreground: a glass jar of water standing on a stone window sill, held up to the light. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, both hands round the jar. Background: a standpipe, the top row of new plots, open hillside. Light: hard bright noon.

Foreground: an oak root ball wrapped in hessian on the tail of a lorry, earth falling from it. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, standing at the tail board. Background: four bare oak trunks lying on the lorry bed, the emptied yard, the hillside. Light: bright May light.

Foreground: one standing oak, trunk pale, a ring of dead grass round its base. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, walking out across the wet field towards it. Background: an empty field, a stone boundary wall, the Brow above. Light: flat grey afternoon.

Foreground: a small iron range with its door ajar and fire showing inside. Middle: an old woman of eighty-four, white hair, a buttoned coat to the throat, seated beside it with her hands in her lap. Background: a plain front room, one chair, a shut front door, a curtained window. Light: firelight on the wall.

Foreground: two wooden chairs set facing each other beside a low fire. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, sitting forward in one of them. Background: the iron range glowing, the shut front door, one curtained window. Light: firelight low in the room.

Foreground: oak pegs in turned shale with a taut string line running between them. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, crouched at a corner peg with his thumb on the string. Background: the Brow top, the Wesset Water below, the roofs of Keld. Light: bright clear afternoon.

Foreground: an oak corner post with its sawn top pale, a hand laid flat on it. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, standing straight with his palm on the post. Background: the beck in the valley, the churchyard corner, the new plots. Light: long late light.

Foreground: a panelled door standing on its edge against a stone wall, its hasp hanging loose. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, holding the two hinge leaves in both hands. Background: the old stone farmhouse, empty window openings, the bare yard. Light: flat overcast light.

Foreground: a gate lying face down in the grass, the top hinge still screwed to it, a loose hinge pin beside. Middle: Perrin Loman, thirteen, straight dark hair, a sunburnt nose, a bright red anorak, kneeling, the pin in his hand. Background: the stone farmhouse on its new plot, a standpipe, four young oaks. Light: evening light.

Foreground: a long wall of flat sheets pinned side by side in a row. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, standing back. Background: the tall north window, boards stacked on edge, a stone-topped bench. Light: flat north daylight.

Foreground: a flat steel ruler laid across a stone-topped bench. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, at the bench with both hands. Background: drawing boards stacked on edge, a rolled sheet of heavy drawing paper in a rack, an inkwell. Light: cold north daylight.

Foreground: a cattle grid of parallel steel bars set flush in the road. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, standing on the tarmac beyond the grid. Background: the road climbing away, a hedge, wide sky. Light: low sun.

Foreground: the flat tarmac of a turning head and the cut face of a hedge. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, standing at the end of the road. Background: open pasture falling away, a drystone wall, a wooded ridge. Light: late afternoon.

Foreground: two glass plates held apart by four brass corners with a lamp glowing under them. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, leaning over the comparator. Background: the tall north window, a stone-topped bench, an inkwell. Light: lamp glow and cold window light.

Foreground: a corner of a sheet lying on the glass, its edge lifting from the plate. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, one fingertip resting beside the corner. Background: the comparator frame, the lamp, boards stacked on edge. Light: lamp glow from below.

Foreground: a ruling pen held in a hand, its point resting on the drawing board. Middle: Thali Oren, sixty-one, the same build, a waistcoat over his shirt, seated at the board, eyes down. Background: drawing boards stacked on edge, an inkwell, a tall north window. Light: north light from behind.

Foreground: a thick file, a quarter of an inch, lying closed on a deal table. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, one hand flat on the cover. Background: bare stone basement walls, a steel shelf, a bare bulb. Light: one low bulb.

Foreground: a flat steel ruler held against a drystone wall, a folded sheet beneath it. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, standing at the wall. Background: the lane falling away, four cottages, a church tower, the ridge. Light: bright summer light.

Foreground: a narrow lane between a drystone wall and a low house wall, puddled. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, walking up the lane. Background: four cottages in a row and a fifth beyond, a church tower, the hillside. Light: bright morning light.

Foreground: a drystone well head with a wooden lid and a rope over a black shaft. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, a levelling staff stood upright beside him. Background: the churchyard wall, the church tower, the lane. Light: flat grey light.

Foreground: a ring binder, fat with loose sheets, lying open on a stone-topped bench. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, turning the pages of it. Background: a tall cupboard of shelves, boards stacked on edge, a north window. Light: cold north daylight.

Foreground: a plane table on three legs, its alidade clamped along the edge. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, sighting along the alidade. Background: open pasture, a church tower far off, a hedge, the ridge. Light: bright summer noon.

Foreground: a trial pit a foot deep in dark peat with a levelling staff standing in it. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, steadying the staff, wet to the knee. Background: open bog, standing water, the far bank. Light: flat white sky.

Foreground: a folding rule held open and flat against a stone wall. Middle: Thali Oren, sixty-one, the same build, a waistcoat, one hand on the rule at the wall. Background: the lane climbing, a cottage, the church tower, the ridge. Light: bright August light.

Foreground: a flat steel ruler and a folded sheet squared to it on a long table. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, seated at one end with his hands flat. Background: a bare committee room, high windows, a plain wall. Light: cold daylight.

Foreground: a long rolled sheet of heavy drawing paper unrolled along the bench, one end still curled. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, one hand on the roll. Background: the tall north window, boards stacked on edge, a lamp. Light: cold north light.

Foreground: a plain buff folder lying closed on a table, its corners squared. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, seated with one hand on the folder. Background: an empty committee room, a chair pushed back, a window. Light: cold afternoon light.

Foreground: a squared folder on a table with a pair of hands flat beside it. Middle: Hollis Bray, a thin man of fifty in a plain suit, seated, one hand squared on the folder. Background: an empty committee room, a jug and glasses on a side table, a window. Light: flat afternoon light.

Foreground: a steering wheel and a dark instrument panel, the lane ahead picked out by the headlamps. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, both hands on the wheel. Background: a dark hedge, a farm gate, a black field. Light: headlamps in the dark.

Foreground: an open folder on the table, one sheet lifted at its corner. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, leaning over it with both hands. Background: a bare wall, a window with rain on it, a jug and glasses. Light: grey daylight.

Foreground: a plain chair by the north window, a coat over its back. Middle: Yasmin Rohr, a woman of fifty, hair going grey at the temples, a long plain coat buttoned, seated with a rolled sheet across her knees. Background: the stone-topped bench, boards stacked on edge, a tall window. Light: cold north light.

Foreground: a ruling pen in a hand, its point set on a drawing board. Middle: Thali Oren, sixty-two, the same build, a waistcoat over his shirt with the cuffs fastened, seated alone at the board. Background: boards stacked on edge, an inkwell, one lamp. Light: a single lamp in a high room.

Foreground: the near corner of a heavy drawing sheet, lifted at one edge. Middle: Thali Oren, sixty-two, the same build, a waistcoat, both hands on the sheet pushing it forward across the bench. Background: the tall north window, an inkwell, boards stacked on edge. Light: cold north daylight.

Foreground: a fresh sheet from the press lying flat on a stone-topped bench, one corner curled. Middle: Corin Oren, twenty-four, short brown hair pushed back, a narrow tired serious face, a plain pale-blue shirt, collar open, sleeves rolled, leaning on the bench. Background: a table by the north window, bound sheets in a rack, a lamp. Light: cold north light.

Foreground: a hand laid flat on a large sheet, a dark smudge of ink at the thumb. Middle: Thali Oren, sixty-two, the same build, a waistcoat, leaning with his palm down on the paper. Background: the tall north window, a rack of bound sheets, the canal far below. Light: north light across the table.
